title: RPHA 1N Quartararo Replica

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Born for the apex and high-speed straightaways, the HJC RPHA 1N Quartararo Replica is born on the race grid to conquer high-speed turbulence. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1471g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~91 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: FIM homologated racing helmet available to the public.

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Track / Race lineup, the RPHA 1N Quartararo Replica brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM track safety.
story:
The HJC RPHA 1N Quartararo Replica represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC RPHA 1N Quartararo Replica delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
